messages:
Alex: Quick preflight for Wed's virtual panel — want to lock the signup LP A/B, Zoom safety checks, and recording ownership so post-event clips and leads route without firefighting.
Priya: LGTM. For the LP test I suggest CTA copy and email field placement. 50/50 split, 24h ramp.
Diego: Zoom checklist: interpretation + breakout ON? Also enable auto-record to cloud, transcript enabled, and waiting room off for smoother join.
Sasha: Ownership note — recordings -> cloud/marketing/webinars/YYYY-MM-DD_panel.mp4, transcripts -> s3 marketing-transcripts/ and tag with event_id.
Maya: Can we add an automated step to split the recording into short clips and create a lead note? I can wire the clip trigger in the postflow.
Alex: Yes — high priority: make sure host & co-host assigned. @Diego can you be host and add @Priya as co-host? :raised_hands:
Diego: I will. Also setting alternative host to @Sasha in case I need to drop.
Priya: LP details: we'll A/B test headline "Benchmarking LLM inference at scale" vs "How we cut token cost 3x". Hidden field: utm_source + demo_interest boolean.
Alex: Good. For leads: any registrant with demo_interest=true -> send to sales queue with tag "webinar-demo"; others -> nurture. Can we do that in Zapier?
Maya: Yep. Zapier filter then HubSpot create/update contact + add to list. I'll add a short delay step to wait for recording to be processed before clip generation.
Sasha: Recording naming convention again? Lowercase, dashes, include event_id and speaker initials.
Alex: Yep: eventid-slate-speakerinitials-session.mp4 e.g., 2026-05-12-rd-jw-keynote.mp4
Diego: Zoom settings snippet I'm using:
```
Auto-recording: Cloud
Audio transcription: Enabled
RTMP fallback: enabled
Meeting passcode: off (we'll use invite link)
Alternative hosts: diego@redwood.com, sasha@redwood.com
```
Priya: LP redirect on submit -> /thanks?event=rd-webinar-2026. Also add pixel for retargeting.
Maya: Post-event pipeline outline: 1) Wait for cloud processing webhook (ZoomBot) 2) Move raw to long-term S3 3) Trigger clipper -> produces 30/60/120s clips + thumbnails 4) Upload clips to CMS + create CRM touch with clip links.
ZoomBot: Meeting created (ID 987654321) scheduled Wed 2026-05-12 10:00 PDT. Recording webhook URL will be posted to #marketing when processing completes.
Sasha: Who owns raw edit? @Maya or @Sasha? We need one editor to own trims.
Maya: I'll own edits for this one. Will hand off final assets to content ops for distribution.
Alex: Great. Last checks: captions on, SRT export, subject line templates for registrants and post-event email. Priya can you draft 3 subject lines today?
Priya: On it. Drafting now, should post to thread before EOD.
Diego: I'll test the RTMP fallback in a quick meeting today and report back here.
Alex: Thanks team. If anything blocks — ping me directly. :rocket:
